params.body:
## Calm cool neutrals from one place, and blue only where it means something

Second step of the look after #913 (Inter, three weights). Colour only: no radius, no badge shape, no weight and no dialog change.

### Why

The greys of the platform were slate: ink, text, lines, field fills, the page ground and the top bar all sat in one blue hue with enough chroma to read as blue. Measured on six screens, 54 to 94% of what was not white was visibly blue, so the brand blue of the one button had nothing to stand against. The values were also spread: the palette in `refresh.css`, a second copy as hex in `tailwind.config.cjs`, a third in the pages that carry their own styles, and some eighty loose hex values between the rules.

### What changed

**One token file, read by every page.** `resources/css/colour.css` holds brand, state and the neutral scale. It is imported at the top of `type.css`, the one stylesheet every page already reads: the app layouts through `tailwind.css`, the guest layout too, and the error pages, the stopped-account page, the public proposal page, the embed docs and the consent page through `<x-ui.type />`. `refresh.css` and `ui.css` are not loaded on those pages, so the tokens could not live there. `tailwind.config.cjs` points every colour at a variable (`rgb(var(--…-rgb) / <alpha-value>)`, so `bg-brand-blue/10` keeps working) and repeats no value; Tailwind's own `gray-*`, which is slate, is mapped onto the same scale.

| Token | Value | Was |
|---|---|---|
| `--ui-ground` (page ground, a well on a card) | `#eef0f2` | `#eaeef4`, `#eef1f5`, `#edf1f5` and four more |
| `--ui-surface` | `#fff` | |
| `--ui-surface-quiet` (band, table head, hovered row, summary) | `#f3f4f6` | blue tints (`#eef4fa`, `rgba(10,143,212,.04 to .07)`) and eleven near-whites |
| `--ui-field` (`--brand-field`) | `#f4f5f6` | `#f4f6f8` |
| `--ui-fill` / `--ui-fill-strong` (track, skeleton, off switch) | `#e3e5e8` / `#cdd0d5` | `#e2e6ec`, `#cfd6de`, `#cbd2dc` and others |
| `--ui-ink-1` (`--brand-ink`) | `#15181d` | `#101828` |
| `--ui-ink-2` (`--brand-gray`) | `#4a4f58` | `#475467`, `#344054` |
| `--ui-ink-3` | `#585d66` | `#667085` |
| `--ui-ink-faint` (`--brand-faint`: placeholder, eyebrow, caption) | `#676c75` | `#98a2b3` (2.58:1 on white) |
| `--ui-icon-quiet` (a mark that is not text) | `#868b94` | `#98a2b3`, `#aeb6bd`, `#aab1b8` |
| `--ui-line-soft` / `--ui-line` / `--ui-line-field` | ink at .06 / .11 / .15 | `rgba(16,24,40,.05 / .10 / .14)` |
| `--ui-topbar` | `#161a20` | `#14181d` |
| `--brand-blue`, `--brand-blue-deep`, `--brand-navy` | unchanged | |
| `--brand-green`, `--brand-amber`, `--brand-red` (fills) | unchanged | |
| `--brand-green-ink` / `--brand-amber-ink` / `--brand-red-ink` (a state word on its soft surface) | `#08724e` / `#8a5708` / `#b33326` | `#0a7d56` / `#b5730f` / `#c0392b` |

The quiet ink is darker than in the prototype (`#868b94` there): that value is 3.4:1 on white and it is used for text, so it became the non-text mark and the text rank moved to 4.6:1 and up.

**The slate values are gone** from `refresh.css` (every one of the loose hexes is now a token or a state colour; `rgba(16,24,40,a)` and `rgba(23,35,48,a)` are `rgb(var(--ui-ink-rgb) / a)`), `ui.css`, `insights.css`, the legacy stylesheets, the theme source (body, ground, text, muted, borders, table lines, links) and the views and chart scripts. `refresh.css` went from 6071 to 6046 lines; the ratchet is lowered.

**Blue stays** on the primary action, links (in the deep shade: 5.45:1), focus rings, what is selected, active or checked (tab, switch, checkbox, filter chip, chosen range in the histogram, the row you came back to), the active item in the top bar, the brand mark and its three stripes beside a price.

**Blue went** from: the hover of a table row, a menu item and a notification (quiet surface); a car name under the pointer; "Nog 6 dagen" on the bidding card and detail (ink at medium weight, "Laatste dag" stays amber; R B1-2.9 and B1-2.11 reworded); icons that are no action (spec groups, block titles in Inzichten, notes, document tiles, the AI mark, the confirm dialog's glyph); tinted panels (the AI block, the damage hint, the modal note, unread notifications, which keep their dot); the "own" pill; the load-more button; section titles and their dash on the vehicle form; the option under the pointer in a select list.

Status colours keep their job. The truck button in the order lists keeps its state colour (requested by the customer): the soft surface is the same, the icon takes the deeper ink of the badge palette so it reads on its tint.

### Blue share, before and after

Method of the prototype: a pixel in hue 190 to 250 with a channel spread of 8 or more counts as visibly blue; images are hidden (content, not interface); 1440 wide, full page, both builds on the same data.

| Screen | visibly blue, share of non-white: before | after | share of the whole screen: before | after | still cool (any blue hue), after |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Transport overview | 94.1% | 24.9% | 36.7% | 9.7% | 94.6% |
| Bidding offers | 63.3% | 8.3% | 50.2% | 6.6% | 87.0% |
| Settings form (location) | 86.9% | 9.0% | 59.8% | 6.2% | 87.2% |
| Stocklist list | 67.7% | 7.5% | 48.1% | 5.3% | 98.2% |
| Own stock list | 53.9% | 17.8% | 32.5% | 11.6% | 86.2% |
| Inzichten | 86.7% | 12.4% | 35.2% | 5.0% | 89.9% |

Saturated brand blue is unchanged (0.3 to 2.1% of a screen). What is left on the transport overview is mostly the top bar.

### Contrast (WCAG 2, ratio to 1)

| Text | on white | on quiet surface | on field | on ground |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ink 1 `#15181d` | 17.79 | 16.17 | 16.30 | 15.57 |
| ink 2 `#4a4f58` | 8.23 | 7.48 | 7.54 | 7.21 |
| ink 3 `#585d66` | 6.62 | 6.01 | 6.06 | 5.79 |
| quiet ink `#676c75` | 5.28 | 4.80 | 4.84 | 4.62 |
| link, blue-deep `#0b6fa8` | 5.45 | 4.95 | 4.99 | 4.77 |
| red `#c0392b` | 5.44 | 4.94 | 4.98 | 4.76 |
| green ink `#08724e` | 5.95 | 5.41 | 5.45 | 5.21 |
| amber ink `#8a5708` | 6.09 | 5.54 | 5.58 | 5.33 |
| red ink `#b33326` | 6.14 | 5.58 | 5.63 | 5.38 |

A state word on its own badge: green 5.18 on white and 4.59 on the ground, amber 5.33 and 4.72, red 5.13 and 4.53; the grey badge 7.29, the muted one 5.86. White on the top bar 17.46; white on a red button 5.44. Non-text: the quiet icon 3.42, the focus ring and a checked control (brand blue) 3.56 on white.

An audit in the browser (every visible text node against its real ground, 23 screens at 1440 and 390) found, before the fixes of this PR: the old faint grey, text in the fill blue (3.56), green and amber words in their fill colour (3.39 and 3.87), the theme's link blue (3.04), the theme's pink danger for the required asterisk and the old badge (3.17), the copyright line on the login page (3.67). All are at 4.5 or more now.

**One pair is left below 4.5, on purpose:** white on the brand blue of the primary button, 3.56:1 (it meets the 3:1 of large text and of a control, not the 4.5 of its 14px label). Brand blue is unchanged in the chosen direction, and the deep blue as the fill (5.45:1) is a visible change of the brand that was not shown yet; it is a decision, not a fix. Also below 3:1 by choice of the look: the edge of a field (1.37, a filled field) and a switch that is off (1.55, the knob says the state).

### Fixed on the walk (1440 and 390)

Stocklist list and detail, own stock list and vehicle form, bidding offers and detail, transport overview and window, worklists, Inzichten, my insights, settings, location form, dealers, users, roles, relations, orders, offers, ongoing biddings, features, login, 404, the public proposal page.

- Links from the bought theme were `#009DE0` (3.04:1): the active tab of the order lists, plain `a`.
- `text-danger` and `badge-danger` of the theme were pink `#e46a76`: now the brand red.
- Green and amber words (`Alles in orde`, `Op Stocklist`, `Er is geen schade`, a draft step) take the ink shade; icons keep the fill.
- "Geen Car-Pass" was set in the icon grey.
- Encoded slate strokes inside SVG data URIs (the select chevron, two icons).
- The pages that carry their own styles (errors, 503, stopped account, proposal, embed docs) read the tokens; the error pages keep the value as a fallback, because they must render without the build. The proposal page no longer copies the palette by hand; the dealer's accent and font stay his.
- Chart scripts take the values of the tokens (an SVG attribute takes no variable); the data colours are unchanged and read on the new ground.

### Tests

- `TheNeutralsLiveInOnePlaceTest` (`@rule P1-1.26`): the scale exists once in `colour.css` and no other stylesheet defines a colour token; `type.css` imports it and the built `type.css` and `tailwind.css` carry it; the Tailwind colours hold no hex and no rgba, and the built classes read the variables; no screen source carries a retired slate value (hex, `%23` in a data URI, or the slate rgba); every ink is 4.5:1 or more on every ground and every state word on its badge; text in the fill blue is left on icons only; the deadline is ink.
- `TheBiddingCardReadsAtAGlanceTest`, `TheBiddingDetailSaysHowLongIsLeftTest`, `ProposalPublicPageTest` updated to the new behaviour.
- Rule R P1-1.26 added next to P1-1.25; B1-2.9 and B1-2.11 reworded.

Mails and PDFs have their own styling and do not follow. The website and the embed of a dealer keep the dealer's colours.
params.title: Calm cool neutrals from one place, and blue only where it means something
